name: 3D Biped
summary: The Leg Lab's unconstrained two-legged runner — the Planar Biped freed from its boom to balance in all three dimensions. It hopped, ran on grass, and in 1992 performed a tucked somersault, the first three-dimensional gymnastic manoeuvre by a legged robot. Rob Playter's thesis on passive dynamics in gymnastic control came out of it; he would later become CEO of Boston Dynamics.
notable: First 3D biped robot to perform a somersault (1992)
Ran outdoors on grass, untethered from the planar constraint
Appeared on screen with Sean Connery and Wesley Snipes in Rising Sun (1993)
